reading.body:
DISKUS Polska is an unverified data center record, not a confirmed facility, and it carries zero megawatts.

The entry comes from a single OpenStreetMap tag in Wieliczka, near Kraków, and no operator website, press coverage, or Polish business registration was confirmed. The name suggests storage or IT, and Kraków is a real technology and outsourcing hub, but neither fact establishes that a data center exists at these coordinates. The record lists a website and a facility ID, which makes it checkable, not verified.

For AI specifically, this is a reminder that facility counts assembled from map tags overstate capacity. A building tagged as a data center tells you nothing about installed compute, contracted power, or whether the site is live. The zero megawatts field is the honest part of this record.

What the data does not cover: any power draw, any operator, any construction date, or any confirmation that the tagged site is a data center at all. It also does not say the facility is absent. It says the claim is unresolved, and the research status is exhausted rather than negative.
